refinement_of_data_lab: data-lab flagged BRE/MCI/HUL/BHA as the heavily-favoured DEF/GK fixture run. FDR-X analysis CONFIRMS BRE (weighted 3.13), MCI (2.80) and BHA (2.80) as genuinely easy over GW3-5, but HUL is actually mid-pack/tough (weighted 3.60, tied with MUN/CHE/ARS) - GW3 is only fdr3 (not fdr2) and GW4 is a tough away fdr4. Recommend treating HUL defenders as a one-week (GW3-only) play rather than a 3-5 week hold; BRE/MCI/BHA remain the stronger multi-week fixture-run holds. LIV is the single best fixture run in the whole player pool (weighted 2.60) and isn't on data-lab's radar - Kerkez (owned) benefits directly.
